changelog:
chatmosp-kmc-simulator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the KMC simulation engine for chatMOSP.
- Runs Windows-based KMC engine (main.exe) via Wine; checks and manages Wine environment.
- Prepares KMC input files and directory structure based on confirmed parameters.
- Executes KMC simulation, warns users of large step counts (≥20M) with estimated time.
- Generates and sends four result plots (coverage and TOF, vs time and steps) as separate messages.
- Automatically regenerates missing plots or on user request; ensures MSR task and parameter-builder prerequisites are met.
summary:
KMC (Kinetic Monte Carlo) simulation engine of the chatMOSP system. Invokes
kmc_standalone.py via Wine to run the Windows main.exe engine, executes
catalyst surface reaction kinetic simulations, and produces TOF / coverage
results.
